description: Apply the classic ROT13 letter rotation — encoding and decoding are the same operation.

faqs.a: Each letter is shifted 13 places in the alphabet. Since 13 is half of 26, applying it twice returns the original text.
ROT13 is a toy cipher for hiding spoilers and puzzle text, not real encryption.
Only A–Z and a–z are rotated; numbers, punctuation and spaces are untouched.

howto: Press Convert — ROT13 encodes and decodes identically.
title: ROT13 Cipher
